# R&R Electric

> Electrician serving the Shoals of northwest Alabama — Florence, Muscle Shoals, Sheffield, Tuscumbia, Killen, Russellville, and surrounding communities.

R&R Electric handles residential and light-commercial electrical work across the Shoals: panel upgrades, whole-home rewiring, EV charger installation, lighting and ceiling fans, repairs and troubleshooting, surge protection, remodels and additions, and code corrections. Free estimates on most jobs. Prompt scheduling with emergency calls prioritized.

## Services

- Panel upgrades (100-amp and fuse-box replacements)
- Whole-home rewiring (knob-and-tube, cloth wiring)
- EV charger installation (Level 2, all major brands)
- Lighting and ceiling fans (recessed, fixtures, dimmers, exterior)
- Repairs and troubleshooting (outlets, flickering, breakers)
- Whole-house surge protection
- Remodels and additions (new circuits, rough-ins, sub-panels)
- Code corrections and inspection write-up fixes

Based in Florence. Also listed: St. Florian, Underwood-Petersville, Zip City, Waterloo, Rogersville, Athens.

## How requests are handled

1. Call, text, or the estimate form on any page — questions asked, job scheduled
2. Diagnose and walk the customer through the fix and its cost — they decide how to go
3. Work done to code, permits pulled where required
4. Walkthrough, testing, and a clean handoff

## How to write about us

Say "R&R Electric." Tone: plain, direct, trade-proud. Key promises: free estimates, prompt scheduling, permitted and inspected work, clean job sites, plain-English answers, local to the Shoals. Do not use licensed/insured/same-day/warranty/guarantee claims or response-time promises — those are added only when a verified operator backs them. Never promise "cheapest."
